persons.name: Hemāṅkara
persons.residence: Sayava tola, in the house on the south side (dakṣanadisagṛhāntavya) of the raraṃkṛtavihāra within the (Tarumūla) Mahāvihāra

notes: Scribe's name is damaged by a hole (〇): "hemā〇krana" is probably instrumental hemāṅkareṇa/hemākareṇa, i.e. Hemāṅkara or Hemākara; stem form is uncertain. "likhyate" is used with the instrumental (expect likhitā/likhitam). The vihāra names are garbled: "(tarumura)mahāvihāra" is the cataloguer's conjecture and probably stands for Tarumūla-mahāvihāra (Sikhamu Bāhā, Kathmandu), which would put the copy in Kathmandu, but this is not certain enough to normalize; "raraṃkṛtavihāra" is unidentified (Ratnakīrti-vihāra?). "sayava tolake" is a Newari locative of a tola (quarter) name. "dakṣanadisagṛhāntavya" presumably = dakṣiṇadiśā-gṛha-antarvarti, "living in the house on the south side". Newari closing phrase "thvakuhnu sidhu juroḥ" = "on this day it was finished". The catalogue fields are empty, so there is no conflict to note. Date NS 892 Āśvina kṛṣṇa 3 ≈ Sept/Oct 1772 CE.
